decision.rationale: All fourteen attacks the prompt names are refuted, and five further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v4 — was verified by opening both Stage A files: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX on subject b8696fd1…, the frozen v4. All seven citations recompute with zero mismatches, and the non-unwrite span contains exactly D-167 through D-195, twenty-nine entries, with D-168 present. Every live-state assertion holds exactly, DR-102's cell is unchanged and SATISFIED, and the lineage claim over D-170 through D-195 was verified across twenty-six decisions. Two attacks were specific to this cycle, which is the first to record a subject following a dual-REJECTed predecessor. The rationale makes substantive claims no earlier entry made — that v3 remasured at HEAD 784a485, was dual-REJECTed under G21LJ-V3-SF1, left leftoverDesignOpenStanding on doctor-actor v6, and that v4 lands the finding on v11 while stating OBL-JOIN-FX-EXECUTION is leftoverDesign false there — and every clause was resolved against v3's and v4's own bytes. And the two frozen predecessors genuinely differ in standing: v2 is stale at 5d5d778 / required-now 26 while v3 sits at the current HEAD with required-now 28 and is unrecordable only because of the rejection. The draft keeps them apart rather than attributing staleness to v3, and labels the v3 pin by its rejection. Three further candidates were examined and recorded as observations, one of them a strength. At zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields CONSENT.
